title: Hisn al-Muslim: Fortress of the Muslim
description: Study Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), compiled by Sa'id ibn Wahf al-Qahtani. This widely beloved collection organizes daily supplications (duas) and remembrances (athkar) for various occasions throughout the day and night, from waking up to going to sleep. Hisn al-Muslim has become one of the most popular Islamic reference works for daily prayers and supplications, drawing its hadiths from authentic sources including Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, and other canonical collections.
